metric.name: AVANCE_ACREDITADO_HACIA_PRODUCCION_DE_LA_CANDIDATA_ACTUAL
metric.method: COUNT_PASS_CHECKPOINTS/10 * 100; report-only subdivisions of the frozen execution path; a source or preview step may pass narrowly without certifying functionality

checks.criterion: Five existing C03 member/active-role source owners repaired and synthetically regressed; NOT deployed writers/real identity proof.
Exact cumulative isolated Preview frontend/read-only scoped functions, asset digest/readback and anonymous denial confirmed.
Effective Firestore direct-get/query denial plus full protected Preview/LIVE backend writer and reader parity; preserve allowed workflows.
Legitimate authenticated multi-UID role×country GT/CO positive/negative permissions, role-switch reload and no stale disclosures.
Commercial T01–T18, financial parity, Inicio goals, Ops/Leads and cross-module actions fully tested with server readback.
Paula targeted visual approval on exact final B4-003 candidate; preserve earlier accepted visual where unaffected.
Siniestros/Cronograma causal regression and authenticated acceptance.
Full Phase A module×role×country×viewport relations E2E, including Endosos, Certificados, Anexos and knowledge.
Final exact-candidate owner UAT and evidence-backed release decision.
Exact immutable Preview artifact to LIVE, backend parity, before/after approved writes, integrity, rollback and live module acceptance.

previewReviewPolicy.alwaysInclude: source commit, build ID, release status, what changed vs last preview, precise module/route/role/country, actions to perform, expected observations, known blockers, do-not-test actions, and how acceptance is recorded
previewReviewPolicy.preservationRule: Earlier Paula visual PASS remains unless reproducible causal regression; missing capability does not become PASS by hiding it.
previewReviewPolicy.credentialRule: Never request passwords, secrets, F12 console, or evidence exposing insurer credentials.

targetReview.actions: Sign in using existing authorized account; inspect visual contrast, automatic centered rotating message, authoritative KPI/metas and GTQ/COP separation; note loading or permission errors
targetReview.expected: No false zero or indefinite loading; approved contrast and no double-click instructions
targetReview.proofLimit: Not a certified real-user authentication test

targetReview.actions: Open roster and permitted directory; if account has assigned roles, select Dirección→Operativo→Asesor→Dirección and navigate back to Inicio
targetReview.expected: Only eligible advisor entries by approved role, no stale role data; role access not widened
targetReview.proofLimit: Do not declare security PASS from UI alone

targetReview.actions: Navigate read-only, examine lists, counts, cartera/salud columns and readiness indicators
targetReview.expected: Sources distinguish pending/denied/ready and IDs remain coherent; do not infer repairs not in released writer backend
targetReview.proofLimit: Full finance reconciliation and writes untested

targetReview.actions: Open, navigate away and back; check whether content/readiness restores without black screen
targetReview.expected: No persistent spinner or wrong-role cached rows
targetReview.proofLimit: Backend multi-UID functional regression still open

targetReview.actions: Check desktop and mobile readability without changing records
targetReview.expected: No overflow, cutoff or unreadable actions

doNotTest: Operational workflow persistence, sent emails or provider delivery
